review:
A mystical moonlit wolf on a 5x3, 10-line grid. The wild doubles any win it completes, which gives the base game a bit of punch.

Three scatters give 15 free spins with every win tripled, and retriggers are unlimited. There's also a card gamble after wins if you want to risk it. Medium volatility, a 4,684x max and an excellent 97.09% RTP, with free spins roughly once every 156 spins. Balanced and good for long sessions.
pros: Excellent 97.09% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
